msg: warning: Variable rmm_lock is used uninitialized!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): 1b48bb3c1af.c (Apache LDAP). Uninitialized value on 'rmm_lock' at line 14, when def(APU_HAS_LDAP) && def(APR_HAS_SHARED_MEMORY). 'char* rmm_lock' is declared at line 11 without initialization. Inside #ifdef APR_HAS_SHARED_MEMORY, apr_rmm_init(rmm_lock) is called at line 14, which passes the uninitialized pointer to printf("%s\n", rmm_lock) — a use of an uninitialized value. The //ERROR comment confirms this is the known vbdb UninitializedVariable bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: APU_HAS_LDAP is required to compile util_ldap_cache_init(), and APR_HAS_SHARED_MEMORY is required to compile the call at line 14. Both conditions are necessary and together sufficient.
